cards.ex: There's a nasty bug going around the office; half the team is out sick.
cards.exUz: Ofisda yomon virus tarqalgan; jamoaning yarmi kasal.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p odamlar orasida tarqalgan kasallik, odatda virus.

cards.ex: He was terrified of kicking the bucket before he saw his grandchildren grow up.
cards.exUz: U nabiralarining o'sganini ko'rmasdan oyoq uzishdan qo'rqardi.
cards.uzDef: O'lish, hayotdan ko'z yummoq (hazilomuz uslubda).

cards.ex: When they found him, he was at death's door; he barely survived.
cards.exUz: Ular uni topganlarida, u o'lim yoqasida edi; u zo'rg'a omon qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda kasal, o'limga yaqin holatda.

cards.ex: The positive test results were a real shot in the arm for the research team.
cards.exUz: Ijobiy test natijalari tadqiqot guruhiga haqiqiy ruhiy ko'tarilish berdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir ko'tarinki ruh beradigan, energiya baxsh etadigan.

cards.ex: Despite being 85, my grandfather is still hale and hearty.
cards.exUz: 85 yoshda bo'lishiga qaramay, bobom hali ham baquvvat va sog'lom.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va kuchli, ayniqsa keksa odam haqida.

cards.ex: She blacked out from the pain and woke up in the hospital.
cards.exUz: U og'riqdan hushdan ketdi va kasalxonada uyg'ondi.
cards.uzDef: Hushni yo'qotish, o'zini bilmay qolish.

cards.ex: Getting vaccinated is a stitch in time to prevent serious illness.
cards.exUz: Vaktsina olish - bu jiddiy kasallikning oldini olish uchun vaqtida chora.
cards.uzDef: Muammo yomonlashmasdan oldin vaqtida hal qilish.

cards.ex: She returned to work with a heavy heart after her mother's passing.
cards.exUz: U onasining vafotidan keyin og'ir yurak bilan ishga qaytdi.
cards.uzDef: Qayg'u va tushkunlik hissi.

cards.ex: The doctor said the virus just needs to run its course.
cards.exUz: Doktor virus o'z yo'lini tugatishi kerak dedi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik davom etishiga ruxsat berish, davolashga urinmaslik.

cards.ex: His surgery was touch-and-go for a while, but he's stable now.
cards.exUz: Uning operatsiyasi bir muddat xavfli ahvolda edi, ammo hozir u barqaror.
cards.uzDef: Natija noma'lum, xavfli vaziyat.

cards.ex: Unfortunately, she suffered a relapse and had to go back to the hospital.
cards.exUz: Afsuski, uning kasalligi qaytaladi va u yana shifoxonaga yotishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan tuzalgandan keyin yana qayta kasallanib qolish.

cards.ex: Stress can often trigger a flare-up of his eczema.
cards.exUz: Stress ko'pincha uning ekzema kasalligini qo'zg'atishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Surunkali kasallikning to'satdan yomonlashuvi.

cards.ex: The doctors are optimistic that he'll make a full recovery after the surgery.
cards.exUz: Shifokorlar uning operatsiyadan keyin to'liq tuzalib ketishiga umid qilishmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan butunlay sog'ayib ketish.

cards.ex: She's pushing through her chemotherapy treatments with incredible strength.
cards.exUz: U kimyoterapiya muolajalariga aql bovar qilmas kuch bilan bardosh beryapti.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay davolanishni davom ettirmoq.

cards.ex: After his illness, he was just a shadow of his former self.
cards.exUz: Kasalligidan so'ng, u o'zining sobiq o'zining soyasi edi, xolos.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi holatdan ancha yomon ahvol.

cards.ex: I felt a cold coming on, so I took some medicine to nip it in the bud.
cards.exUz: Men shamollashni his qildim, shuning uchun uni boshlanishida yo'q qilish uchun dori ichdim.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikni boshlanishida tezda to'xtatish.

cards.ex: The doctor said he's finally turned the corner and is starting to recover.
cards.exUz: Shifokor uning nihoyat yaxshilanishga yuz tutganini va tuzala boshlaganini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikning eng yomon davri o'tib, tuzalish boshlanishi.

cards.ex: It's always a good idea to get a second opinion, especially with a serious diagnosis.
cards.exUz: Har doim ikkinchi bir fikr olish yaxshi, ayniqsa jiddiy tashxis bilan.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa shifokordan tashxis yoki davolash haqida fikr so'rash.

cards.ex: After a good night's sleep, I felt as right as rain.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi tun uyqusidan so'ng, men o'zimni butunlay sog'lom his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay sog'lom va baquvvat holatda bo'lish.

cards.ex: After the accident, he was on the critical list for several days.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisadan so'ng, u bir necha kun og'ir ahvoldagi bemorlar ro'yxatida edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda og'ir ahvolda bo'lgan bemorlar ro'yxatida bo'lish.

cards.ex: She's being kept under observation in the hospital overnight.
cards.exUz: U tun bo'yi kasalxonada kuzatuv ostida saqlanmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shifokorlar tomonidan kuzatuv ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: He was recently diagnosed with diabetes.
cards.exUz: Unga yaqinda diabet tashxisi qo'yildi.
cards.uzDef: Shifokor tomonidan biror kasallik aniqlangan.

cards.ex: My grandmother has been bedridden for the past few months.
cards.exUz: Mening buvim so'nggi bir necha oy davomida to'shakda yotib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallik tufayli to'shakda yotishga majbur bo'lish.

cards.ex: The doctor prescribed a course of antibiotics.
cards.exUz: Shifokor antibiotiklar kursi buyurdi.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lum vaqt davomida olib boriladigan davolash usuli.

cards.ex: I thought I was getting better, but I think I peaked too soon; I feel awful again.
cards.exUz: Men yaxshilashayapman deb o'ylagandim, lekin menimcha, erta yaxshilashibman; yana o'zimni juda yomon his qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan keyin erta yaxshilanish va keyin yomonlashish.

cards.ex: She seems to hale from a family with strong genes; they all recover quickly.
cards.exUz: Uning oilasi sog'lom genlarga ega ko'rinadi; ularning hammasi tezda tuzaladi.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom kelib chiqish, kasallikdan tez tiklanish.

cards.ex: Just stay home and rest; you need to get it out of your system.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki uyda qolib dam oling; siz uni organizmdan chiqarishingiz kerak.
cards.term: get it out of your system
cards.uzDef: Kasallikni to'liq o'tkazish, organizmdan chiqarish.

cards.ex: I feel like death warmed over; I can barely move.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimni o'likdek his qilyapman; zo'rg'a harakatlana olaman.
cards.uzDef: Juda yomon ahvolda bo'lish, o'likdek his qilish.

cards.ex: The doctor recommended that I convalesce at home for a week.
cards.exUz: Doktor menga bir hafta uyda dam olib tuzalishni tavsiya qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kasallikdan keyin uyda dam olib sog'ayish.

cards.ex: She's been battling a lingering illness for months.
cards.exUz: U bir necha oydan beri cho'zilgan kasallik bilan kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davom etadigan kasallik.
